input: # Base-prefixed runs with a dot continuation are NOT numbers: the whole run
# falls to the lenient text scanner as ONE string. The TS scanner previously
# claimed the prefix and emitted the trailing fixed token at the wrong
# position, eating the run's first character and fabricating list elements:
# No input in this class may fabricate an element or lose a character.
# Empty-body and malformed base prefixes: lenient text, both ports, unchanged.
# Numeric separators are legal only BETWEEN the digits of a run. A run whose
# separator touches a run edge (adjacent to the sign, leading, or trailing)
# is not a number at all. The Go scanner previously swallowed edge
# separators — +_1 parsed as the number 1, silently changing user data —
# and the TS fraction shape accidentally admitted a separator-led run
# Interior separators, including consecutive ones and base-prefixed bodies,
